fieldValues.title: A decision that cannot be made now is recorded at once as a proposal
fieldValues.decision_question: What happens to a decision that cannot be made in the moment?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner on 2026-10-15, in a clerked session. Proposed in clerk#57 as parking a decision as an exercise; the owner corrected it: an exercise records a discussion working towards shared understanding and is not a decision. A decision starts as a proposal, is held and may move through many sessions.
fieldValues.decision_statement: A decision that cannot be made in the moment is recorded at once as a proposal in the log of the level that owns it.
fieldValues.rationale: A decision held only in someone's head is lost when the working window closes, and the work stalls. Recorded as a proposal, it is held and appears on that level's agenda until a session ratifies it or sets it aside; discussion that builds understanding around it is recorded as exercises and comments.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When proposals regularly wait longer than two sessions without being taken up.
